rules: group g = positions [4g, 4g+4); closes in call [s, e) when 4g+3 < e; closed after e = e // 4
open tok_k tail after e = positions [4*(e//4), e), at most 3 rows
row t sees groups < t // 4 (own group excluded); picked = min(511, t // 4); cells = 4*picked + (t % 4 + 1) <= 2048; dense causal while t // 4 <= 511 (t < 2048)
score columns of a call = e // 4 (pooled keys written before scoring); rows per sub-chunk = floor(256 MiB / (16 heads * cols * 4 B))
MTP layer: call [s, e) runs rows [mtp_len, e - 1); the last prompt row runs at the first decode cycle (PLAN-addons §2.4); slot index p = MTP row p (its RoPE position is UNVERIFIED, §2.1)
disk block i = latent rows [256i, 256i+256) and pooled rows [64i, 64i+64); with MTP the 13th layer lags one row, so at a 256-aligned trunk length the MTP layer holds 255 tail rows
